newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News wants to sell ANM stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News wants to sell ANM stake - paper.

text.p: News Corp Ltd has asked an investment bank to find a buyer for its 50 percent stake in Australian Newsprint Mills, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday.

"The Australian arm of News has commissioned adviser Baring Bros Burrows to seek a buyer for the stake after talks with the other half owner, Fletcher Challenge Ltd, broke down last year," the newspaper said.
News had aimed to sell the stake to Fletcher for A$300 million, but Fletcher refused as it was only prepared to pay half that amount, the newspaper said.
Fletcher, however, maintains it has the first right to buy the Australian Newsprint Mills stake.
"This means that if News finds a buyer Fletcher will have the right to match the bid or possible vetor the proposed buyer," the Herald said.
Australian Newsprint Mills supplies about 70 percent of Australia's newsprint market.
News reportedly told analysts last month it wanted to sell about US$800 million worth of assets to finance its expansion into U.S. satellite television.
